answer: Every newcomer clears a bond and two audits. The applicant locks 200 units in a vault and sends a proof bundle, a device attestation and one checkable job, to two random auditors, each holding a mirror copy. Both mirrors must sign in 14 days; if either finds a duplicate device or recycled job, the bond burns and the application dies. Approved bundles enter the reef, a log chaining each entry to the two before it, so copies collide with originals. A farmer wanting 1,000 puppets posts 1,000 bonds and faces 2,000 audits; an honest applicant pays once, reclaiming the bond after a year.
